title: ModularPacks-Resources
body:
# ModularPacks Resources
ModularPacks Resources is the official resource pack for the ModularPacks Paper plugin. Instead of leaving backpacks and upgrades as generic vanilla-looking items, this pack gives them a consistent visual identity with custom models and themed textures. The goal is to make backpack progression and installed modules easier to read at a glance while keeping all gameplay logic on the plugin side. This pack is built to complement ModularPacks, not replace it. The plugin handles backpack identity, storage, module behavior, and data. The resource pack handles visual presentation. ## Features - Custom backpack item visuals - Custom module and medallion visuals - Model mapping designed around ModularPacks item definitions - Improved visual clarity for module-heavy backpacks - Vanilla-client friendly resource-pack workflow - Designed to stay in sync with ongoing ModularPacks development
Requirements and installation ## Requirements - Minecraft Java Edition with resource packs enabled - A server running the ModularPacks plugin - Recommended: matching versions of plugin and resource pack ## Installation 1. Download the resource pack. 2. Place it in your client resource packs folder, or let your server distribute it. 3. Enable the pack in Minecraft. 4. Join a server running ModularPacks. 5. Verify that ModularPacks CustomModelData values are configured as expected. If models do not appear correctly, check: - Pack load order - Resource pack conflicts - Server-side ModularPacks config values for model data
Design goals and compatibility ## What this pack is for Many server plugins focus on features first and visuals later. ModularPacks Resources is meant to close that gap by giving backpacks and upgrades a cohesive in-game look that matches the plugin’s modular design. The intention is not to force one style, but to provide an official baseline that feels intentional, readable, and expandable. ## Compatibility notes - This is a resource pack, not a gameplay plugin - No client mod loader is required - Works alongside the ModularPacks plugin on vanilla clients Intended for servers that want the full visual ModularPacks experience
Related project ## ModularPacks plugin This resource pack is made for the ModularPacks plugin, which can be found [here](https://modrinth.com/plugin/modularpacks).
